subject: Native positioning diagnostic smoke stopped before the ownership gate
question: Does an actual goto_position request reach the observed ownership gate and return its same-read diagnostic on the available host?

reverify.command: On an owned disposable saved project, hold the existing exclusive live lane and run an immutable clean attested server with no competing tests or servers. Independently identify the current project, stopped transport and exact playhead before mutation. Request goto_position for a different complete musical position. Preserve preflight refusal rather than dismissing an unknown dialog or bypassing a guard. Only when preflight permits the operation, retain the same-read frontmost observation for each actual AX/CG attempt, independently read the resulting playhead, and inverse-write/read the complete original position if movement occurred. Stop the server and verify PID disappearance and lock release. Repeat the reporter scenario on an actual Logic 12.4 host before declaring that issue resolved.
reverify.expected: A refusal before channel execution is not ownership-gate qualification. An executed gate reports its actual retained reason, focus-read status and only available sanitized structural facts. An unavailable AX focus read retains the legacy window-based decision; an unread owner/window or readable mismatched focus does not authorize mutation. Actual movement and restoration need independent complete-position readings.
reverify.cost: Requires an owned disposable Logic fixture and exclusive native lane; about 5 minutes on a supported host. Reporter reproduction also requires Logic 12.4.

method: The existing attested-build script built clean debug candidate 4534434234c88abd7483b307c0eb2a738d915b49 with matching embedded commit at 2026-10-04T22:58:02Z. A real MCP server initialized on the actual exclusive live lane. Project and transport resources were read before two actual goto_position requests. Both refused before channel execution because preflight observed an AXDialog with a window-sharing control; screen observation showed the sharing HUD. No control was pressed or guard waived. The second call followed reset of screen observation and a wait and had the same refusal. Selected actual responses exclude private project/window titles, paths and human-readable hints; unchanged private raw transcript is identified by hash. The host block was generated by Scripts/observation_host.py, not copied from another record. No native record_sequence request was sent.
